<!--
  A whole sign-in page: the AuthCard placed in the page. Axes: layout (split: a picture panel beside the card,
  centered: the card on a tinted page, minimal: the card alone in a narrow column), side (end, start: the side
  of the picture), mode, social. The page's heading is the card's title.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { AuthSwitch, AuthVisual } from "./auth-layout.types";
import type { AuthLabels } from "./auth-card.types";

export type AuthLayoutProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  text: string;
  submit: string;
  switchTo: AuthSwitch;
  labels: AuthLabels;
  visual: AuthVisual;
  level?: 1 | 2;
  layout?: "split" | "centered" | "minimal";
  side?: "end" | "start";
  mode?: "signin" | "signup" | "reset" | "magic";
  social?: "none" | "show" | "first";
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Block from "../primitives/block/block.vue";
import Box from "../primitives/box/box.vue";
import Container from "../primitives/container/container.vue";
import Grid from "../primitives/grid/grid.vue";
import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.vue";
import Text from "../primitives/text/text.vue";
import Title from "../primitives/title/title.vue";
import AuthCard from "../blocks/auth-card.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import { cn } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  text,
  submit,
  switchTo,
  labels,
  visual,
  level = 1,
  layout = "split",
  side = "end",
  mode = "signin",
  social = "none",
} = defineProps<AuthLayoutProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <Block tag="div" class="w-full" data-testid="auth-layout" :data-layout="layout">
    <Container :class="cn('mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4', 'py-12')" data-slot="container">
      <Grid v-if="((layout as string) === 'split')" cols="1-2" class="items-stretch gap-8">
        <Box class="mx-auto flex w-full max-w-sm items-center">
          <AuthCard
            :id="id"
            :title="title"
            :text="text"
            :submit="submit"
            :switchText="switchTo.text"
            :switchLink="switchTo.link"
            :switchHref="switchTo.href"
            :labels="labels"
            :mode="mode"
            layout="plain"
            :social="social"
            :level="level"
          />
        </Box>
        <Stack
          gap="4"
          align="stretch"
          :class="cn(
            'justify-end rounded bg-muted p-8',
            (((side as string) === 'start') ? 'md:order-first' : 'md:order-last')
          )"
          data-testid="visual"
        >
          <MediaFrame :alt="visual.title" ratio="4/3" />
          <Title :as="2" size="2xl" weight="bold">
            {{ visual.title }}
          </Title>
          <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
            {{ visual.text }}
          </Text>
        </Stack>
      </Grid>
      <Box v-else-if="((layout as string) === 'centered')" class="mx-auto w-full max-w-md rounded bg-muted p-6">
        <AuthCard
          :id="id"
          :title="title"
          :text="text"
          :submit="submit"
          :switchText="switchTo.text"
          :switchLink="switchTo.link"
          :switchHref="switchTo.href"
          :labels="labels"
          :mode="mode"
          layout="card"
          :social="social"
          :level="level"
        />
      </Box>
      <Box v-else class="mx-auto w-full max-w-sm">
        <AuthCard
          :id="id"
          :title="title"
          :text="text"
          :submit="submit"
          :switchText="switchTo.text"
          :switchLink="switchTo.link"
          :switchHref="switchTo.href"
          :labels="labels"
          :mode="mode"
          layout="plain"
          :social="social"
          :level="level"
        />
      </Box>
    </Container>
  </Block>
</template>
